₹1 lakh of gold: how much loan can you get?

Under the RBI's gold-loan rules in force from 1 April 2026, a loan of up to ₹2.5 lakh can be at most 85% of the gold's value (80% for ₹2.5–5 lakh, 75% above ₹5 lakh).
So ₹1 lakh of gold gets you a loan of up to ₹85,000.
Once you repay, the lender must return your gold within 7 working days, or pay ₹5,000 compensation for each day of delay.

Have you or your family ever pledged gold for a loan?

Sources: a business news report on the RBI's gold-loan directions (Oct 2025); two lenders' education pages on loan-to-value limits and borrower rights. ₹1 lakh is illustrative.
